responsibility: Implements the C-SKY backend’s core target logic and TARGET_* hooks that sit behind the machine description. It owns register-class tables, address-cost modeling, condition-code register conventions, builtin type initialization such as __fp16, argument accumulation state, libfunc/optab setup for integer and floating runtime operations, and many target helper routines declared in csky-protos.h for operand handling, code emission, prologue/epilogue support, PIC/TLS legalization, and other RTL-generation decisions consumed by the .md patterns.
same_name_distinction: This is the executable C++ implementation file for the C-SKY port: it defines backend data and target hook functions, performs builtin/libfunc initialization, and supplies helper logic invoked by generated recognizers and patterns. Unlike csky.h it declares little policy surface itself, unlike csky.md it does not encode RTL instruction patterns, and unlike csky.opt it does not define command-line options.
